title: Space governance posture: implementation-defined
description:
Permanent record. The JMAP Chat spec (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00) declares Space governance to be implementation-defined.

Decision: There is no `ownerId` field on Space or Chat. There is no normative "owner" principal for Space governance. The spec mechanism is members + roles + permissions; the creator becomes a member with a server-defined bootstrap role that grants sufficient admin permissions. Last-administrator protection and destroy authorization are server-defined. See §Space Governance: Deployment Variation (anchor: {#space-deployment}) in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md.

Reverses the prior locked-in single-owner direction. Spec-side counterpart to JMAP-g7wu.2.4.12 in the sibling JMAP workspace at ~/PROJECT/JMAP, which is tracking the implementation-side revert of JMAP-g7wu.2.4.11.

Spec commit: refactor: implementation-defined Space governance (this bead is filed concurrently with that commit).
notes: Filed and closed in the same operation as a permanent record of the governance posture. Not actionable work — informational pin only.
close_reason: Permanent record. Spec governance posture is captured in §Space Governance: Deployment Variation in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md. No further action; this bead exists only as a searchable pin.
